notes.title: Heroes of Drakemire Launched on Steam!
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

The day to begin your epic adventures in Drakemire has come! Today [b]Heroes of Drakemire is out on Steam for USD $19.99, GBP £16.75, Euros €19.50 with a 15% discount for launch![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2152580/Heroes_Of_Drakemire/

Embark on a grand adventure in Heroes of Drakemire, where the fate of a mesmerizing world balances on the edge. Cultivate a party of distinctive heroes, and journey through vast, danger-filled maps in this turn-based adventure inspired by classic JRPGs. With every challenge you overcome, you're one step closer to becoming Drakemire's most celebrated hero. And remember, amidst the thrill of the quest, there's always time for pie!

Heroes of Drakemire had been in development for [b]just over 4 years[/b] and today we are finally ready to share our game with all our Heroes! We would also like to thank all the help we’ve gotten along the way from everyone that contributed to this project, and assisted our solo dev in creating Heroes of Drakemire! And of course, all our players and beta testers that are with us on this journey. We truly hope that you enjoy this Drakemire as much as we’ve enjoyed creating it!

Stay connected with us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/HeroesofDrakemire/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/HeroesDrakemire]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/heroesofdrakemire/]Instagram[/url] for the latest Heroes of Drakemire news and announcements, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ndMrWwgtFN]Discord server[/url] to become a part of the community of Heroes!

notes.title: Heroes of Drakemire Coming October 26th!
notes.content:

notes.title: Heroes of Drakemire Closed Beta & Raffle!
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

We’re incredibly excited to welcome you all to our second closed beta of Heroes of Drakemire!

We truly value any and all feedback we receive, and as a token of our gratitude, we will be holding a raffle among all our testers who provide us with feedback at the end of our closed beta! [b]For every 5 beta testers that provide us with feedback, we’ll be raffling a $10 Steam Gift Card![/b] The raffle will be held on our Discord server after the feedback deadline, on October 9th!

[b]Sign-ups start today![/b] The testing period will begin on [b]September 22nd and end on October 6th![/b] The deadline for feedback will be on October 9th! Afterwards, we will hold the raffle and announce the winners on our Discord server. All participants must be on our server during the raffle!

If you’d like to participate in our closed beta, all you need to do is [url=https://discord.gg/ndMrWwgtFN]join our community on Discord[/url], and fill out this Google Form!

https://forms.gle/Yt7fv5iyo5FQanXX9


Stay connected with us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/HeroesofDrakemire/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/HeroesDrakemire]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/heroesofdrakemire/]Instagram[/url] for the latest Heroes of Drakemire news and announcements, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ndMrWwgtFN]Discord[/url] server to become a part of the community of Heroes!

notes.title: 1K Steam Wishlists Giveaway
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

A message came from far away lands of a glittering prize for the most committed of warriors! 

With many quests to complete and enemies to slay, take a respite during this small event from the chaos in Drakemire. Starting from the 25th, we will be launching a Gleam Campaign with the prize of [b]3x $10 Steam Gift Cards to celebrate 1,000 wishlists![/b] To participate head over to [url=https://gleam.io/V1Tca/heroes-of-drakemire-1k-wishlists-giveaway]this link[/url] and complete the tasks to increase your chances of winning! 

Good luck heroes, we can’t wait to see you in game!

notes.title: The Heroes of Drakemire Demo is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43281706/15346e70540f18f919ec5b3c10921ad7b7f591b1.png[/img]

Greetings Heroes!

We're thrilled to announce that the Heroes of Drakemire demo is now available to play!

Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a newcomer to JRPG’s, this is the perfect opportunity to dive headfirst into thrilling turn-based combat and memorable quests. 

Journey alongside Brutus and his loyal companions, navigate a realm filled with unique characters, captivating stories and brace yourself for challenges that test the ties of family, friendship, and destiny. And remember: even in the heart of chaos, there's always time for pie!

If you’d like to discuss the game and chat with the developer, join the [url=https://discord.gg/ndMrWwgtFN]Heroes of Drakemire community on Discord![/url]

Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/heroesofdrakemire/]Facebook,[/url] [url=https://twitter.com/HeroesDrakemire]Twitter,[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/heroesofdrakemire/]Instagram[/url] for the latest developer updates and news.
